description: Variant of the review of the commit that gave Python its files' bytes (PEP 263) and read mangled and context aliases: `from pytest import skip as stop` marks `stop` (its import holds `skip`), `omit = stop.__call__` marks `omit` (its value holds a marked name), and head adds `omit("x")`: at least a WARN that it may skip `test_adds`, never silence. The real runner skips it.
